slides.head_en: Who / which: after a noun with ال
slides.head_ar: نَقُولُ الَّذِي أَوِ الَّتِي أَوِ الَّذِينَ بَعْدَ اسْمٍ مَعَهُ «ال».

slides.note: The noun before it must have ال (it is a known noun).

slides.head_en: Look: no noun before — مَنْ and مَا
slides.head_ar: اِقْرَأْ: بِلَا اسْمٍ قَبْلَهَا، مَنْ وَمَا

slides.head_en: مَنْ and مَا: no noun needed

slides.big_en: Start of a sentence = a question. In the middle = “the one who / what”.
slides.small: The small word tells you more about the noun before it.

slides.why: Wrong! It needs a noun with ال: الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي كَتَبَ.
slides.why_ar: خَطَأٌ! بَعْدَ الَّذِي اسْمٌ مَعَهُ «ال»: الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي كَتَبَ.
